item.title: Overview of Amos - God's Impartial Grace 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # On a warm afternoon, a community art studio hummed with quiet concentration. Children and adults sat at pottery wheels, each trying to coax beauty out of a stubborn lump of clay. Among them was a young girl who had saved her pocket money for weeks to make a gift “beautiful enough for Mum.” She pressed her palms against the clay, trying to shape it into a small vase. But the clay wobbled. She pressed harder. It bulged. She tried to steady it. It collapsed into a shapeless heap.

item.title: Overview of Joel - Hearing God in Seasons of Loss 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # She had never read the book of Joel. In fact, she had never even paused long enough to wonder what might be inside those three short chapters tucked quietly among the Minor Prophets. Her Bible reading habits had always gravitated toward the familiar, the comforting cadence of the Psalms, the narrative sweep of Genesis, the clarity of the Gospels. Joel, by contrast, felt like a sealed room in an old house: present, but unexplored; small, but somehow intimidating.
